subject: Questions on VentureBridge early-access credits & packaging
messages:
From: Ari Noor <ari@venturebridge.co>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VentureBridge — early-access credit and sponsor packaging question

Hi Connor,

Quick question on packaging for our fall cohort (VentureBridge Fall '26). We typically offer each accepted team a $5k sponsor stipend; several of our startup sponsors have asked if those stipends can be used together with your early-access promo credits (we were quoted a cohort promo during the accelerator partner call). Two clarifications would help us run this in time for onboarding:

1) Can VentureBridge stipends (sponsor-funded credits) be stacked/combined with Redwood early-access promotional credits for the same account? If there are stacking caps, what are they?
2) If a startup wants to convert credits to a longer-term reserved capacity (Dedicated) later in the program, is there a standard conversion rate or credit ladder we should tee up in our MA/offer letter?

Also, our security/compliance team will need a SOC2 snapshot for any credits that touch production data — do you have a short cert stub we can attach to the cohort portal?

Attached: VentureBridge_Sponsor_Summary.pdf (one-pager for the sponsors).

Appreciate a short reply or a pointer to the right person. We need to finalize the sponsor-facing docs by next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Ari Noor
Head of Partnerships | VentureBridge
ari@venturebridge.co
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
To: Ari Noor <ari@venturebridge.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VentureBridge — early-access credit and sponsor packaging question

Hi Ari — thanks for the clear ask and for the one-pager. Quick answers inline below and looping in Marissa (startup programs) and Laura (billing) to confirm details and next steps.

1) Stacking: Short answer — yes, we can stack sponsor-funded stipends with a Redwood early-access promo, but there are program caps. Typical max combined credits we allow for cohort packages is $20,000 per account (promo + stipend) unless we carve out an exception via a program addendum.

2) Conversion to Dedicated: We offer a credit-conversion path but it requires an explicit conversion addendum. Typical conversion is a percentage of remaining promo credits that can be applied toward a Dedicated commitment; percentage varies by cohort volume and timing. Marissa will propose the standard conversion ladder we use for similar partners.

SOC2: Laura will attach a short SOC2 stub and the compliance contact if you need an expanded package.

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize the MA language and the sponsor-facing one-pager. Working times: 10–11am PT or 2–4pm PT.

—Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (206) 555-0198

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Ari — great to meet (virtually) and thanks for the one-pager. Adding concrete options so you can pick what maps to VentureBridge's sponsor model quickly. Below are two practical packaging options we use for accelerators: pick A or B and we’ll draft MA language.

Option A — Cohort Promo + Sponsor Stipend (recommended, simplest)
- Redwood early-access promo: $15,000 account credit (one-time allocation per accepted team).
- Sponsor stipend: up to $5,000 per team, labeled as sponsor-funded credits.
- Stacking cap: combined promo + stipend capped at $20,000 per account. Any sponsor-funded credit above that cap requires an exception approved by Redwood Partnerships.
- Conversion to Dedicated: Remaining credits may be applied toward a Dedicated commitment at a 40% conversion credit rate (i.e., $1,000 of remaining promo credits = $400 credit toward a Dedicated monthly commitment) if the conversion is executed within 12 months of credit issuance. Conversion requires a short addendum and a committed minimum (usually a 6-mo reserved pool).

Option B — Promo with Dedicated-Conversion Accelerator (preferred for startups expecting production usage)
- Cohort promo: $10,000 account credit + eligibility for a one-time 25% discount on a 6-month Dedicated trial if they convert within 90 days.
- Sponsor stipend: up to $5k, stacking cap same as above.
- This option reduces upfront credits but gives immediate Dedicated discounts for teams that plan to scale quickly.

Other notes:
- Tax and invoicing: Sponsor-funded stipends are invoiced to the sponsor (we can route invoices to you or to your sponsors directly). Laura, can confirm invoicing flow and whether VentureBridge wants sponsor invoices on VB letterhead.
- SOC2: attaching a short stub (Redwood_SOC2_stub.pdf). If your security team needs the full report or auditor contact we can provide an NDA route.
- DocuSign: I’ve prepared a one-page amendment template and will send a DocuSign link once you pick option A or B.

Next step: If you want a single-line summary for founders, we can provide a one-page “what this means” (1) credit totals, (2) stacking rules, (3) conversion path. We can have a draft by EOD today if you confirm the preferred option.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Startup Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (347) 555-0144
